Name: Rare Screemu

Description.name: Rare Screemu
Description.description: It's not often that a full-grown Gigacheep soars overhead... but when it happens, it's an experience not easily forgotten. That must've been what happened to inspire the design of the Rare Screemu; the Monster would like to think that it was a spitting image of the fledgling form of the avian Titan... but in truth, it's a bird-brained notion that it could ever pass for anything other than a Rare Wublin.

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Rare Screemu
